svg.title: From a job to an ordered graph of actions
svg.desc: Simplified: one retrieve job, no other trays. The job becomes four AGV actions, then six actions with the bay's; the remaining steps execute them.
svg.metadata: ["Input: one job. Retrieve the vehicle on tray T17 at bay B21. The job states the goal, not the moves.", "The job becomes four AGV actions, in a chain: drive to tray T17, lift it, carry it to bay B21, lower it.", "Two bay actions complete the plan: switch to retrieve mode before the carry, hand the vehicle over after the lower. Six actions, ordered by arrows: this is the output.", "Execution. Bay B21 switches to retrieve mode. It has no predecessor, so it starts at once.", "AGV-1 drives from waypoint W26 to stall P17 and stops under tray T17.", "AGV-1 lifts tray T17 with the vehicle on it.", "AGV-1 carries tray T17 to bay B21. This action waited for two predecessors: the lift, and the bay's retrieve mode.", "AGV-1 lowers tray T17 in bay B21.", "Bay B21 hands the vehicle over to the customer. Every action ran when its predecessors were complete; no clock was needed."]
